Description.SourceString: 默认获取
Description.LocalizedString: Default Acquisition

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D四队队长白藏的名片。
陈述简洁，排版清晰，正经得不像是白藏的名片——当然，也确实不是他自己制作的。显而易见，功劳都得归结于他那靠谱的副队。至于他的态度嘛……一张小小的纸片而已，如何定义得了一个活生生的、复杂的人呢？
Description.LocalizedString:
Baicang's namecard as the Captain of ETD-4.
Concise wording, clean layout, and so professional that it doesn't seem like Baicang's card at all. Of course, that's because he didn't actually make it himself. All credit goes to his dependable Lieutenant. As for Baicang's take on it… well, how could a little piece of paper ever define a living, complex person?

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」收容二组薄荷的名片。
看到这张名片，是不是就会想起薄荷呢？那就立刻打开呗果，和薄荷聊聊天吧！薄荷的话匣子里总是有聊不完的话题，她绝对会第一时间回复你！当然了，出勤时间除外。
Description.LocalizedString:
Mint's namecard as a member of CSU-2.
Does seeing this card make you think of Mint? Then open up Bagel and chat with her right away! Mint's always got endless topics to talk about, and she'll absolutely reply in a flash! Well, except when she's on duty, of course.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 法帝娅羁遇等级10级奖励

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D四队队员法帝娅的名片。
当名片上印着一个热烈乖张的口红印时，接收方往往会露出一个有趣的表情。譬如，误认作一场邀约的窃喜；跳脱于正常社交范围的尴尬；一闪而过的鄙夷……实际上，这只是一个测试游戏。她从中窥见对方的底色，并乐此不疲。
Description.LocalizedString:
Fadia's namecard as a member of ETD-4.
When a bold and provocative lipstick mark is printed on a namecard, the recipient tends to have an interesting reaction. A secret thrill from mistaking it for an invitation, perhaps. The awkwardness of something beyond normal social norms. A fleeting flash of disdain… In truth, it's all just a little test. She uses it to catch a glimpse of their true colors, and she never gets tired of it.

Description.SourceString:
「斯特利速递」代理店长九原的名片。
这张名片由斯特利统一制作，照片是其中固定的部分。当它被递到你手中时，便意味着交易早已悄然开始——只是多数人总要等到很久以后，才会真正明白自己究竟同意了些什么。
Description.LocalizedString:
Jiuyuan's namecard as the acting owner of Sterry Express.
The card was produced by Sterry in a standardized format, with the photo being a fixed element. The moment it's placed in your hands, a transaction has already quietly begun. It's just that most people don't realize what they've actually agreed to until much, much later.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉羁遇等级10级奖励

Description.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店」店员娜娜莉的名片。
凹凸有形的纸面暗纹（睡觉时压皱的）、低奢的配色（彩印经费不够）、隐约可见的装饰性线条（手抖涂出去了）……种种细节彰显着名片持有者神秘且高贵的身份。这个叫「老大的派头」，相信有人能懂。
Description.LocalizedString:
Nanally's namecard as a staff member of Eibon Antique Shop.
The textured watermark patterns on the paper (crumpled from sleeping on it), the understated luxury color scheme (ran out of budget for color printing), the faintly visible decorative lines (hand slipped while drawing)… Every detail speaks to the mysterious and noble identity of the card's owner. She calls this "boss vibes." Surely someone out there gets it.

Description.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店」店员早雾的名片。
「什么叫你还没有名片？柯林斯家族的成员怎么能没有名片，快做一张去！」因为这种原因诞生的名片，不知道早雾对这张名片到底是什么态度，至少娜娜莉很满意。
Description.LocalizedString:
Sakiri's namecard as a staff member of Eibon Antique Shop.
"What do you mean you don't have a namecard? How can a member of The Coluccis not have a namecard? Go get one made right now!" This namecard was born from that exact demand. It's unclear how Sakiri actually feels about it, but at least Nanally is satisfied.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 阿德勒羁遇等级10级奖励

Description.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店」管家的正式名片。
持本名片到店可享受伊波恩管家亲自招待并有优惠折扣！但对阿德勒先生本人来说，这张名片的存在意味着漂泊半生的旅人，也终于有了歇脚之处。
Description.LocalizedString:
The official namecard of the Butler of Eibon Antique Shop.
Present this card at the shop to receive personal service from the Eibon Butler, along with a special discount! But for Adler himself, the very existence of this card signifies something more: a wanderer who drifted through half a lifetime has finally found a place to call home.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 哈索尔羁遇等级10级奖励

Description.SourceString:
「斯特利速递」精英快递员哈索尔的名片。
这张名片由斯特利统一制作，上面的照片并非随意选取。它本身不意味着任何担保，却传递着一个无声的讯息：至少有人，已将你最坏的处境预先思量周全。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hathor's namecard as an Elite Courier of Sterry Express.
This card was produced by Sterry in a standardized format, but the photo on it was not chosen at random. It doesn't promise any guarantees, yet it carries a silent message: at the very least, someone has already thought through your worst possible situations in advance.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 哈尼娅羁遇等级10级奖励

Description.SourceString:
「斯特利速递」精英快递员哈尼娅的名片。
这张名片由斯特利统一制作，但显然在拍摄时候加入了一点哈尼娅本人的小巧思。递出名片的时候应该说：樱花雨落下的时候，能不能再见面？
Description.LocalizedString:
Haniel's namecard as an Elite Courier of Sterry Express.
The card was produced by Sterry in a standardized format, but Haniel clearly added a little personal touch during the photoshoot. Apparently, when handing over the card, she's supposed to say: "When the cherry blossoms fall like rain, will we meet again?"

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔羁遇等级10级奖励

Description.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店」店员达芙蒂尔的名片。
人拥有名片意味着什么呢？就好像狗狗拥有了写着自己名字的铭牌吗？她尚且不太明白其中的含义。唯独能确信的是——以前，她总是在不同的任务中使用不同的姓名代号。现在，她只要做「达芙蒂尔」就可以。
Description.LocalizedString:
Daffodill's namecard as a staff member of Eibon Antique Shop.
What does it mean for a person to have a namecard? Is it like a dog having a tag with its name on it? She doesn't quite understand the significance yet. But one thing she knows for certain: before, she always used different codenames for different missions. Now, she just needs to be Daffodill.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 埃德嘉羁遇等级10级奖励

Description.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店」店员埃德嘉的名片。
照片出自埃德嘉的个人简历。埃德嘉为应聘伊波恩古董店做足了准备……实际上，都没派上用场。
不过，被埃德嘉当作「面试官」尊敬的塔吉多过足了瘾。
Description.LocalizedString:
Edgar's namecard as a staff member of Eibon Antique Shop.
The photo is from Edgar's personal resume. Edgar went all out preparing to apply for a position at Eibon Antique Shop… but in the end, none of it was actually necessary.
Still, Taygedo, whom Edgar respectfully treated as the "interviewer," got a real kick out of it.

Description.SourceString:
「粉爪银行」大堂经理的私人名片。
出自小吱在拍入职照时被同事抓拍的一张，只会送给亲近的人。入职本司请牢记——《粉爪银行员工守则第一条》：「浪漫」。
Description.LocalizedString:
Chiz's namecard as the Lobby Manager of Pink Paws Bank.
The photo on the card is a candid shot taken by a colleague during her onboarding photoshoot. She only gives this card to those close to her. A reminder to all who join the company: Pink Paws Bank Employee Code, Rule #1: Romantic.

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D四队副队长翳的名片。
名片应包含基本姓名、职位、公司全称、详细地址和有效联络方式，如电话号码、邮箱、呗果账号和芝码等，确保客户和合作伙伴能够便捷地取得联系——而这张在统一格式下制作的名片似乎稍显信息不足，翳颇有微词。
Description.LocalizedString:
Skia's namecard as Lieutenant of ETD-4.
A namecard should include essential information such as the holder's name, title, full company name, detailed address, and valid contact methods like phone number, email, Bagel account, and Sesame Codes, ensuring that clients and partners can easily get in touch. However, this card, produced in a standardized format, seems to fall short on information. Skia is not amused.

Description.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店」店长浔的名片。
几乎每一桩结局是被次品、假货所骗的古董收购交易，都通过这张名片找到了浔的头上。所以她偶尔会掏出来打量，寻思着是不是照片文字在设计布局上的位置出了什么毛病……风水角度的。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hotori's namecard as the Owner of Eibon Antique Shop.
Almost every antique acquisition deal that ends with the buyer being duped by fakes or inferior goods somehow traces back to Hotori through this card. So every now and then, she takes it out for a good look, wondering if there's something wrong with the placement of the photo and text in the layout… from a feng shui perspective.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 安魂曲羁遇等级10级奖励

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D四队队员安魂曲的……名片？
「把这张卡片递给别人，不需要自我介绍，大家也能认识你。」听上去好像很方便，所以安魂曲也学着做了……或许照片不太正式，但确实令人印象深刻。
Description.LocalizedString:
Lacrimosa's… namecard? As a member of ETD-4.
"Just hand this card to someone, and they'll know who you are without any introductions." Sounded convenient enough, so Lacrimosa decided to make one herself… The photo might not be the most professional, but it certainly leaves an impression.

Description.SourceString:
「玉饼街居民协会」街道管理员海月的名片。
整条街上，人人都认识这位勤恳尽责的管理员；新人初来乍到，也往往先被拉着认遍了各家店铺，才来得及问一声她的名字。于是，上岗时印的一整盒名片，至今原封不动地放在海月桌上。
Description.LocalizedString:
The namecard of Aurelia, the administrator of the Tamamochi Street.
Everyone on Tamamochi Street knows about her. When newcomers arrive, she usually drags them around to every shop in town before they even have a chance to ask her for her name. No wonder the box full of namecards that she printed when she took the job remains untouched.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 卡厄斯羁遇等级10级奖励

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」E.T.D六队队员卡厄斯的名片。
为数不多仅存着的完好的一张名片，与它同时印刷的那些名片其中有一半成为廷达罗斯的玩具，毕竟狗狗的天性就是搞破坏；还有一半随机遗失在城市各处，变成了打进卡厄斯手机里的推销电话。还好异象管理局印发员工名片是免费的。
Description.LocalizedString:
A namecard belonging to Chaos, a member of ETD-6.
One of the few copies still intact. Half of the original batch became Tindalos's toys—dogs are born to destroy things, after all. The other half were scattered across the city and somehow turned into telemarketing calls to Chaos's phone. Good thing Bureau of Anomaly Control employee namecards are free.

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」C.S.U二组成员真红的名片。
收容组每天打交道的异象多半不具备辨识文字的知性，工作的危害程度也没高到会像E.T.D那样时常碰上需要向受害市民抱歉地递出名片的窘境——那还有什么场合会用得上这些印发的纸片呢？只是某种猜测，也许管理局内部有人会把它们当做集换式卡牌来收集……
Description.LocalizedString:
Namecard of Shinku, a member of the Bureau of Anomaly Control's CSU-2.
Most Anomalies handled by the Containment Units each day are not exactly known for their reading skills, and the work rarely places them in ETD's awkward position of handing out namecards while apologizing to affected civilians. So when would these little printed slips ever prove useful? One can only guess—but perhaps someone within the Bureau collects them like trading cards…

Description.SourceString: 「这可是只有本老大才能找到的，绝佳的观景点！」
Description.LocalizedString: Exclusive boss-level vantage point. Don't even think about trying to find it yourself!

Description.SourceString: 白藏被抓拍到的一张照片。「难得」的休息时光，当然要好好享受啦！
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Baicang. He's having his "precious" resting time. Of course he's chilling.

Description.SourceString: 薄荷被抓拍到的一张照片。这是什么？薄荷味的冰淇淋！咬一口！
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Mint. What's this? Mint ice cream? Nom nom nom!

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 法帝娅觉醒等级6级奖励

Description.SourceString: 法帝娅被抓拍到的一张照片。熟悉她的人都知道，每当她露出这个表情时，意味着游戏才刚刚开始。
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Fadia. For those who know her, whenever she wears that expression, it means the game has just begun.

Description.SourceString: 九原被抓拍到的一张照片。玫瑰的芳香指引你来此地，趁着夜色未阑，与她共饮一杯吧。
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Jiuyuan. The fragrance of roses has guided you here. While the night is still young, share a drink with her.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉觉醒等级6级奖励

Description.SourceString: 娜娜莉被抓拍到的一张照片。挣开重力的枷锁，少女跳跃在颠倒的世界之间。
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Nanally. The maiden breaks away from gravity and leaps through the inverted world.

Description.SourceString: 早雾被抓拍到的一张照片。喏，这个给你——什么？才……才不是特意给你留的！
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Sakiri. Oi, take this. What…? It's not like I saved it for you!

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 阿德勒觉醒等级6级奖励

Description.SourceString: 阿德勒被抓拍到的一张照片。对于阿德勒先生这样的管家来说，完美不过是日常。
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Adler. For a butler like Adler, perfection is to be expected.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 哈索尔觉醒等级6级奖励

Description.SourceString: 哈索尔被抓拍到的一张照片。不知从何时起，她渐渐发觉，沿途的风景原来这般美好。
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Hathor. At some point, she started to realize the journey before the destination had great views.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 哈尼娅觉醒等级6级奖励

Description.SourceString: 哈尼娅被抓拍到的一张照片。总有一天，全海特洛都会认可她的歌声，毕竟，这可是无敌的哈尼娅！
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Haniel. One day, all of Hethereau will be listening to her songs. After all, it's the invincible Haniel!

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔觉醒等级6级奖励

Description.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔被抓拍到的一张照片。除了原本的职责外，达芙蒂尔还负责看着挑食的孩子把蔬菜全都咽下去。
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Daffodill. Apart from her usual duties, Daffodill is responsible for making sure those picky eaters eat their veggies.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 埃德嘉觉醒等级6级奖励

Description.SourceString: 埃德嘉被抓拍到的一张照片。Tayge! Tayge Tayge!（埃德嘉！全伊波恩！拼拼图最快！塔吉多！亲自认证！）
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Edgar. Tayge! Tayge Tayge! (Edgar! Best at puzzles! At Eibon! Taygedo certifies!)

Description.SourceString: 小吱被抓拍到的一张照片。不要被外表迷惑哦，超强的业务能力才是小吱真正的「杀手锏」。
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Chiz. Don't be fooled by her looks. Her true strength is in her business skills.

Description.SourceString: 翳被抓拍到的一张照片。偶尔放松的时候，他也会允许自己陷入回忆的漩涡中。
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Skia. Sometimes when Skia is relaxing, he allows his memories to haunt him.

Description.SourceString: 浔被抓拍到的一张照片。遇到稀罕宝贝，不论价值几何，该出手时就出手，这是浔一贯的作风。
Description.LocalizedString: A candid photo of Hotori. When she spots a rare treasure, price is never the question. She always knows when to make her move

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 安魂曲觉醒等级6级奖励

Description.SourceString: 安魂曲被抓拍到的一张照片。如果天上那个圆圆的东西是番茄的话，想必能做出好多好多番茄酱吧……
Description.LocalizedString: A snapshot of Lacrimosa. If that round-shaped thing up there were a tomato, it could make a lot of Tomato Jelly…

Description.SourceString: 海月被抓拍到的一张照片。有时候，海月仍会思念她最好的朋友们：就像踏上旅程的人，偶尔也会回望故乡。
Description.LocalizedString: A candid photo of Aurelia. She still sometimes thinks of her closest friends, like a traveler glancing back at home.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 卡厄斯觉醒等级6级奖励

Description.SourceString: 卡厄斯被抓拍到的一张照片。异象管理局为许多特殊员工开办了「现代智能设备常识课」，尽管如此，卡厄斯还是需要队长私下为他开小灶，以免挂科。
Description.LocalizedString: A candid photo of Chaos. The Bureau of Anomaly Control runs a "Modern Smart Device Basics" course for many of its special employees. Chaos, however, still needs Captain to tutor him on the side if he has any hope of passing.

Description.SourceString: 真红被抓拍到的一张照片。C.S.U偶尔可以放开手脚去对付棘手的目标，因此也会留下一些时髦的影像——但还是不建议市民在尚未确认异象泯除时就拿着照片去索要签名。
Description.LocalizedString: A candid snapshot of Shinku. CSU occasionally gets to cut loose against troublesome targets, leaving behind some pretty stylish shots—but citizens are still advised not to ask for autographs until the Anomaly has been confirmed nullified.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多APP-兑换中心内获得
UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Obtained from the Taygedo App – Exchange Center.

Description.SourceString: 一样的词语是怎么翻译出那么多种意思的呢？
Description.LocalizedString: How does one phrase end up with so many meanings?

Description.SourceString: 从前森林里有一个爱穿红外套的小女孩，因此大家都叫她「安魂曲」。
Description.LocalizedString: Once upon a time, there was a little girl who lived in the forest and loved wearing a red coat. Everyone called her "Lacrimosa."

Description.SourceString: 新鲜出炉的热乎帖子，记得点赞关注收藏！
Description.LocalizedString: A freshly baked Bagel post. Remember to like, follow, and save!

Description.SourceString: 全海特洛市最美味的泡芙！
Description.LocalizedString: The tastiest cream puff in all of Hethereau!

Description.SourceString: 肆虐的狂风，是时候停下了。
Description.LocalizedString: Even the raging gale must come to rest.

UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Obtained from the Everdriving Mystery Box.

Description.SourceString: 或许那真是一道影子，不然为何连最昂贵的相机也无法捕捉它的身形？
Description.LocalizedString: Perhaps it truly is only a shadow. Why else would even the finest camera fail to capture its form?

Description.SourceString: 夏天到了！和朋友们一起出去玩吧！
Description.LocalizedString: Summer has arrived! Grab your friends and make the most of it.

Description.SourceString: 从今天起，你就是绵绵村永远的荣誉村民啦！
Description.LocalizedString: From this day forward, you're an honorary villager of Fuzzy Village—forever!

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 伊洛伊羁遇等级10级奖励

Description.SourceString:
「异象管理局」C.S.U二组成员奥涅伊洛伊的名片。
一张照片，还有一个名字。这是她出生时父母所起的名字，在遥远的传说里这似乎也是一位司梦的神明。名字像咒语似的贴在她头上，她的异能是拜此所赐吗？或是那位神明早知道自己要将奇迹加诸她身，于是暗自在她父母起名时，挑起关于这名字的念头？纠结错乱的问题在她脑子里飘来飘去，撞到脑门掉到地上，没有回音，没有答案。
Description.LocalizedString:
Namecard of Oneiroi, a member of the Bureau of Anomaly Control's CSU-2.
A photograph, and a name. It is the name her parents gave her at birth—and in some distant legend, it also seems to belong to a god who rules over dreams. The name clings to her like an incantation. Was her Esper Ability granted because of it? Or had that god already foreseen the miracle that would be bestowed upon her, quietly planting this name in her parents' minds before they chose it? Tangled, disordered questions drift through her thoughts, bump against her forehead, and fall to the floor—without echo, without answer.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 伊洛伊觉醒等级6级奖励

Description.SourceString: 伊洛伊被抓拍到的一张照片。罐头里面有什么？咖啡？可乐？还是异象？
